game.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War
game.blurb: Military first-person shooter from Treyarch and Raven Software, with Beenox, Sledgehammer Games, High Moon Studios and Activision Shanghai (as RAWG lists them), released 2020-11-13. RAWG average playtime: 11 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign
chapters.summary: Finishing the campaign and each story mission: Nowhere Left to Run, Fracture Jaw, Brick in the Wall, Redlight, Greenlight, Echoes of a Cold War, Desperate Measures, End of the Line, Break on Through, The Final Countdown and Ashes to Ashes.

chapters.title: Side Operations
chapters.summary: The two optional operations, Operation Chaos and Operation Red Circus.

chapters.title: Mission Challenges and Weapons
chapters.summary: Feats inside particular missions (targets, bow kills, barrels, the AC-130, memory endings, a door you are told not to open, vehicles and mortar teams), plus body shields and weapon kill counts.

chapters.title: Veteran and Realism
chapters.summary: Finishing the campaign on Veteran or Realism difficulty.

chapters.title: Multiplayer
chapters.summary: Eliminations, match wins, Scorestreak kills, vehicle kills and Fireteam squad wipes.

chapters.title: Zombies
chapters.summary: Skill and Perk upgrades and the Die Maschine challenges, plus four hidden Zombies achievements.

chapters.title: Dead Ops Arcade
chapters.summary: The top-down arcade mode: chicken chains, the Wild, the Mamaback, the Room of Fate and Deadly Dungeons.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). The game is on Steam as app 1985810 ("Call of Duty®: Black Ops Cold War"), so the Steam list was used. StrategyWiki has no page under "Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War" or "Call of Duty Black Ops Cold War" (also tried "Call of Duty: Black Ops – Cold War"). callofduty.fandom.com answers the API under "Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War" with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 4 of 44 Steam achievements are hidden ("Heavy Metal", "Carpe D.I.E.M.", "Seal the Deal" and "Two Birds, One Stone"); their Steam API names start ZM_SILVER_ like the visible Zombies ones, so they were put in the Zombies chapter rather than the campaign. Other API name prefixes are CP_ (campaign), MP_ (multiplayer) and DOA_ (Dead Ops Arcade). The campaign chapter lists missions in Steam list order, which may not be play order. "Survive the Wild" (Escape from the deep dark Wild) was placed in Dead Ops Arcade by its DOA_ API name.
